_note: A SUBSET of config/settings.yaml, same nesting, same key paths. The UI reads tunables
from here so no number is hard-coded in the JS (CLAUDE.md: no magic numbers).
This file is the fallback only. ui/serve.py serves the REAL config/settings.yaml at
GET /api/config, and the M3 FastAPI process should serve the same path; the client
tries that first and drops back to this file when the endpoint is absent (e.g. a
plain static preview). Keep the two in sync - tests/test_ui.py asserts the values
config/settings.yaml is owned by another module; nothing here edits it.
